title: campyloneurum pittieri
intro: Campyloneurum pittieri, commonly known as Pittier's spleenwort, is a species of fern in the family Polypodiaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Campyloneurum pittieri include wound healing, anti-edema, and antiseptic effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
